result.summary: The page has a misleading active navigation state and low-contrast promotional text.

issues.description: The small white promotional text has insufficient contrast against the green banner.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or use a darker text color to improve readability.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted even though the page displays the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Highlight Home as the active tab when the Home feed is displayed.
